Messages.Author: Thrall of Arika



Now that's really hard for me to understand.

By far the Bloodlines clan that was most improved was !Salubri.

Can you really be saying the the group 2 Kiasyd are weak and
unplayable? While I don't think the new Kiasyd are bad, I don't see
them any more powerful or able than the original 5. Bartholomew is a
bloodgain bouncing star, Julia Prima is a bleeder extraordinaire.
Beatrice is a solid midcap. Marconius has votes, strength and the
reducing cost special. Okay, I grant you, Kassiym Malikhair isn't that
hot, though fairly solid disciplines for a 6 cap.

Perhaps the biggest star in the new Kiasyd is Quincy, since his special
so messes with the Imbued. And since he's group 3, he easily meshes in
with the 'old schoool' Kiasyd. Omme is a mini-Marconius, and
Pherydima's untap is pretty nifty. Roderick's equip is a bit iffy, at
least for me, as I don't often play that much equipment with Kiasyd,
though I don't deny it's potentially useful with the right deck. Though
I do admit that Dame Hollerton outshines Beatrice.

But to say they're vastly superior to the older Kiasyd? Nope, just
don't buy it. Even with the new ones, I still play with the originals.
I do like most of the new cards ... Song of Pan is great! Still not
sure I have a use for the Redcap, though. Suppose it works well if
you're looking to get into more fights with them.

In fact, I found most of the new bloodline vamps to be not as good as
the originals. The only ones I found to be on a truely equal footing
are the Scarce clans, except for the Nagaraja, who I just find
especially lacking. And the !Salubri are an exception to this, of
course, suddenly leaping forward into a very playable and powerful
bloodline.

Chris, Thrall of Arika

Agreed, because they were so shitty to begin with. But the Kiasyd were
"nice" before, maybe just not as a whole clan : I included Julia and
sometimes Kassiym Malikhair (was a very good midcap Dom / Obt for G2...) in
Lasombra decks, and Bart + Beatrice in some weird necrauspex decks, but when
I tried in competitions to make a real Kiasyd deck I had to face facts :
they were just not good enough. Reasons detailed below.

> Can you really be saying the the group 2 Kiasyd are weak and
> unplayable? While I don't think the new Kiasyd are bad, I don't see
> them any more powerful or able than the original 5. Bartholomew is a
> bloodgain bouncing star,

At least he looks like it. But he really isn't. Let's look at the options
that allow us to actually gain pool and use him for bounce (before 3rd Ed)

- first he has to be untapped at the end of your turn (Metro Underground,
Mylan etc), already needs special setup)

- Telepathic Misdirection will tap him, so he can't use his special ;
meaning any bleed for more than 1 will render his special obsolete ; also, 2
other Kiasyd have inf Aus, so they will need skills / Sanguine ; such setup
doesn't help with the flow of a s'n'b deck, trust me.

- He has inf Dom so he'll also tap with Deflections, and see above about the
necessary setup

- the inf Dom also means that you'll have to pay 8 pool for a vamp who can't
govern down, and probably not be governed down in time (only Marconius could
do it, requires 3 turns to get out, see below) : the blood you think you
gain with his special in fact equals to blood and time you don't gain with
Governs, and that's very bad.

Not to mention that his inf Obt in a s'n'b deck isn't what I'd call "good
news"...

So as I said I'll only play him in trick decks, but have to insist that he's
not very competitive.

> Julia Prima is a bleeder extraordinaire.

On that I can only agree, obviously, and she's currently the only reason why
I'd play G2 obt / dom s'n'b (along with fear of contest), but not in a full
kyasid deck.

Also, she isn't that good in a kyasid deck : she can't use superior Aura
Absorption for stealth, Stone Travel against combat or Fae Contortion for
stealth... No, really, she's only a great Lasombra... without access to
Lasombra cards. :-?

> Beatrice is a solid midcap.

No she's not. She doesn't have Obt, meaning so S:CE for her.

> Marconius has votes, strength and the
> reducing cost special.

He costs 9, if you want to play vote Lasombras are better, he's too big for
a s'n'b deck, and although it's tempting to try fighting decks with him, it
isn't, of course, very good.
As for his special, it is only useful with Myt cards that cost blood :
Basilisk's touch is very marginal, Steal the Mind is pure crap, and Redcap
Wilder could be nice in trick decks but isn't really needed for good bleeds.
So Marconius won't see the nightlight in most of my Kiasyd decks.

> Okay, I grant you, Kassiym Malikhair isn't that
> hot, though fairly solid disciplines for a 6 cap.

lol. Well, he was pretty good in G2 !! OBT + MYT means he can play Stone
Travel as well as Shroud of Absence, Fae Contortion + S:CE, and even just
with Obt / Dom he was comparable to Lasombra 6-Cap ; not anymore, obviously.

> Perhaps the biggest star in the new Kiasyd is Quincy, since his special
> so messes with the Imbued. And since he's group 3, he easily meshes in
> with the 'old schoool' Kiasyd.

Agreed, but then he's also a very good friend of G4s so let's not mention
him here.

> Omme is a mini-Marconius,

No. Ohme is a 7-cap bleeder with both stealth disciplines at sup and,
barring Gratiano, 3 votes. The fact he pays one less blood for cards that
are mostly free or uninteresting is a cornercase issue here.

> and
> Pherydima's untap is pretty nifty.

Yes. But the more nifty part is that she already has inf Obt, as Bart, but
at least she has DOM ! And although I'd prefer her without a Bishop title
(for Anarchy) it's one more vote ; she was the only one in G4 with Obt / Nec
but it looks like we're getting more (although I want even moooooore !!).

> Roderick's equip is a bit iffy, at
> least for me, as I don't often play that much equipment with Kiasyd,
> though I don't deny it's potentially useful with the right deck.

Agreed. Still, another 7-Cap, this time with DOM.

> Though
> I do admit that Dame Hollerton outshines Beatrice.

By far.

> But to say they're vastly superior to the older Kiasyd?

Yes they are. They have much better discipline synergy, the average crypt is
lower (G2 = 5 + 6 + 7 + 8 + 9 / 5 = 7, G4 = 5 + 7 + 7 + 8 / 4 = 6,75), the
better spread of DOM means they will come out cheaper and faster ; the only
two downsides are : only 5 G3-G4 as of now (but as some of the others were
really not good it isn't that much of a downside) and the absence of
crosstable effect without Julia (but then you have more votes so you can
deal to some extent). On the whole, they are much, much more competitive.

> Nope, just
> don't buy it. Even with the new ones, I still play with the originals.

Good for you. You have the right to like them. But please don't try telling
us the G2, as a clan, were better than the G4 : they are good for the spirit
in which they were, officially, conceived : as additions to other "main"
clans.

> I do like most of the new cards ... Song of Pan is great!

Of course.

> Still not
> sure I have a use for the Redcap, though. Suppose it works well if
> you're looking to get into more fights with them.

Not worth it.

Of course you're missing one of the best Myt cards : Fae Contortion !!

> In fact, I found most of the new bloodline vamps to be not as good as
> the originals.

Too long to develop now for me, but too wide a statement to be true. Just as
examples : Tupdogs and Blood Sisters offer totally new possibilities. For
the rest, we'd have to compare vamp / on vamp ; trouble being that the G4
bloodlines currently hold one less vamp than G2, Gargoyles, Blood Brothers
and Scarce clans excepted.

> The only ones I found to be on a truely equal footing
> are the Scarce clans,

Salubri are good, Trujahs have some use although I'm still fan of some
strategies available only to the previous ones.

> except for the Nagaraja, who I just find
> especially lacking.

Always did, always will. This clan is the "scarcestest" ever, only Le Din
Tho really exists ! ;-)

> And the !Salubri are an exception to this, of
> course, suddenly leaping forward into a very playable and powerful
> bloodline.

Yes, although it relies a lot in the new G3 vamp and the new cards, so now
I've actually seen some good G2-G3 !Salubri decks too !! :-)
--
